# {{ ibm_cloud_name }} VPC Block CSI Driver Operator {#persistent-storage-csi-ibm-cloud-vpc-block_{{ context }}}

You can provision and manage {{ ibm_cloud_name }} Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) Block Storage in OpenShift Container Platform using the {{ ibm_cloud_name }} VPC Block Container Storage Interface (CSI) Driver Operator and driver, which provide dynamic volume provisioning.
